ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a calculated white-to-black pixel ratio below 0.05, excluding the water/foam interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented field covering approximately 95% of the visible surface. High-intensity (light) clusters are concentrated at the distal lateral tips. Sparse distribution of individual white punctate pixels and thin linear marks across the central and medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; internal angle approximately 55 degrees with a vertical pixel depth of approximately 12% relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks. A distinct, wider indentation (notch-like irregularity) is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the median notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep originating from the peduncle, trending upward and outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular/ellipsoid light-colored pixels (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer margins of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (scratches); most prominent is a short horizontal mark located on the left lobe near the median notch, and several diagonal rake-like marks on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral distal extremities; multiple superficial linear rake marks across the ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: The localized barnacle growth creates a unique textured, irregular boundary at the distal-most points of the lobes.
